title: Agent Decision-Event — substrate ingest boundary object (v1, FROZEN)
description: The integration contract between an agent execution substrate and AILedger's decision memorialization. Substrate agents EMIT these; AILedger ingests, validates, and records them. Frozen v1: required fields and semantics never change; producers MAY add fields (additionalProperties true — version-tolerant by design). Canonicalization for digests is RFC 8785 (JCS); see ailedger_detection.canonical.

warrant.description: why this decision, and not the alternatives

rejected_alternatives.description: at least one rejected alternative, or the explicit 'no-looser-alternative-at-standard' sentinel — an unexplained empty set is unrepresentable

group.description: protected-class label for detection; null = unlabeled (counted, never silently dropped)

positive.description: the outcome polarity detection reads (e.g. approved/hired)

bucket.description: the distribution cell drift compares (becomes decision_type)
